meta.title: Find in conversations
meta.description: Ctrl+F full-text search across every workspace and conversation, reasoning and conversation side by side, plus a gallery of conversation images and videos with right-click open-location or delete.

label.title: Find in conversations
label.empty: Type text, then press Enter or click Find.
label.ready: Press Enter or click Find to search.
label.hideArchivedHint: Leave hits from archived conversations out of the panes
label.noResultsHidden: Nothing to show: {count} more match(es) sit in archived conversations, which you chose to hide
label.truncated: Too many results, showing the first {count}
label.hint: Enter or Find to search · click a result to jump · Esc close
label.mediaEmpty: No images or videos found yet.
label.mediaHint: Click a workspace or conversation to fold it · click a thumbnail to enlarge · Esc to close
label.mediaRefreshHint: Re-read the workspace and conversation list (no conversation is read)
label.mediaCollapseAllHint: Fold every workspace and conversation, leaving only the outline (nothing re-read)
label.mediaExpandAllHint: Read every conversation and load all images and videos (slow)
label.speakerFiltered: Nothing to show: {count} hit(s) hidden by the source filter
label.archivedNotice: This conversation is archived and cannot be opened. Unarchive it from the sidebar list, then try again.
label.deleteProtected: This is a conversation attachment; deleting it would break that conversation permanently, so only the folder can be opened.
label.revealMissing: The file is no longer at that location
